name: autoresearchclaw-pdk-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is AutoResearchClaw, an autonomous research pipeline that turns a research topic into a
paper through 23 stages. Its human-in-the-loop (HITL) layer lets a person supervise a run: intervention modes and
per-stage policies decide where the pipeline pauses, asks for approval or opens a collaboration, gate stages block
until they are approved or rejected, and adapters, workshops and guardrails support that review.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the human-in-the-loop and co-pilot layer of this repository: the researchclaw/hitl/, researchclaw/copilot/ and researchclaw/collaboration/ packages, the pipeline stage state machine (researchclaw/pipeline/stages.py) and the stage contracts (researchclaw/pipeline/contracts.py), together with the documentation pages README.md, docs/HITL_GUIDE.md and docs/integration-guide.md and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
in-package docstrings, including their examples; in-package code comments are only supporting
evidence, and when a comment conflicts with the documentation, follow the documentation.

The environment runs Python 3.11 with t
